user.title: Blind Pilot
user.description: Shared inputs for all blinds. Add each blind afterwards from the integration page.

data.lux_sunny: Light level that counts as sunny
data.throttle_soc: Battery charge at which the inverter throttles the panels

data_description.weather_entity: Supplies today's forecast high and a cloud-cover fallback.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Optional. While it reads below the cool-day temperature, sun is welcome unless the day is hot.
data_description.lux_entity: Optional. When set, it replaces solar panel power as the sun sensor.
data_description.lux_sunny: For a sky-facing sensor with the sun high. Scaled down automatically when the sun is low.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Optional. Needed when the inverter cannot export, so a full battery makes panel power read low.
data_description.start_time: Blinds are never moved before this time.
data_description.end_time: Blinds are never moved after this time.

data.name: Name
data.limit_glare: Limit glare while the room is comfortable
data.patch_depth: How far the sun may reach into the room

data_description.azimuth: Compass bearing: 90 is east, 180 south, 225 south-west.
data_description.glass_height: From the floor to the top of the glass.
data_description.overhang: How far a fixed overhang at the top of the glass sticks out. 0 for none.
data_description.limit_glare: Off keeps the blind open on mild days until the room is too warm.
data_description.patch_depth: Only used while glare limiting is on.
data_description.min_position: 0 lets the blind close fully, which suits see-through fabric.
data_description.wait_for_hand_open: Off lets the blind be raised at the start of the active hours.
data_description.door_entity: Optional. The blind is not moved while this is open.
data_description.pv_entity: Optional. Pick the string that faces most like this window.
